start: Demo gym open as the owner

user_sees: 'People who can sign in' with the sample staff, the owner row 'Signed in on 2 devices'
must_not: A real mobile number of a real person
A call to the gym server

steps.action: Open Member questions and answer one; open Messages and send one to members
user_sees: The answer shows in the thread; the message shows as sent in the list
must_not: A push or WhatsApp sent to anyone
'Sent' words that promise a real member got it without the demo strip in view

steps.action: Open Shop, PT bookings, Challenges, Diet, Measurements, Gym timings, Plan requests
user_sees: Each page full of sample rows and usable
must_not: A page stuck on 'Loading…' because the pretend server has no answer for a call

start: Demo gym opened as the front desk (/demo?as=desk)

steps.action: Open Staff & sign-in, then try an owner-only page
user_sees: 'Only an owner can add people or make sign-in codes. Ask your gym owner.'
must_not: The pretend server answering an owner-only call for the desk

start: Demo gym, a shop order waiting and a plan request waiting

steps.action: Mark the order given, approve the plan request, tick a trainer in Staff & sign-in
user_sees: Each moves to its done state and Today's counts go down
must_not: A count on Today that does not match the page behind it

user_sees: All three are back to the starting state
must_not: A half-kept state (one kept, others not)

start: Demo gym, pages that would use a real person's data

steps.action: Tap 'Make sign-in code' on a sample person and 'Send on WhatsApp'
user_sees: A code sheet for the sample person; WhatsApp, if it opens, is the prospect's own app with a made-up number
must_not: A real sign-in code made on the gym server
A message sent by MettleUp to any number
